results.question: Explain how a trip of K-301 can cause PSV-204 to lift.
results.reason: The assistant's answer accurately captures all the key facts from the reference answer, including the mechanism of vapour backing up into V-203, the pressure rise, the specific pressure values, and the resulting lift of PSV-204 to flare.
results.answer: When K-301 trips, compression stops. Vapour that was being pulled forward backs up into the upstream separator V-203. Pressure in V-203 rises rapidly—in this event from 6.2 barg to 9.8 barg in about four minutes—until it reaches the set pressure of PSV-204 (10.0 barg), at which point the relief valve lifts and discharges to flare [504bb2a40e87251c].
